newsitem.title: USA: Eastern Environmental in two acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Environmental in two acquisitions.

text.p: Eastern Environmental Services Inc said Tuesday that it has acquired the Oak Avenue Inc landfill in Perryville, Md.
Terms of the acquisitions were not disclosed.
The company said that the landfill has about nine million cubic yards of existing gate capacity and is projected to have revenues of about $6 million annually.

Eastern also announced that it has completed the acquisition of Waste X, a collection company in Miami which provides collection services to commercial and residential customers in Miami and Fort Lauderdale, Fla. It also has annual revenues of about $6 million.
Eastern Environmental is a non-hazardous solid waste management company.
